title: Back to School at Forty-One
script: Radio Host: [warmly] This morning we're speaking with Rina, who returned to university at forty-one after nearly two decades away from formal study. Rina, welcome.
Rina: [a little nervous] Thank you. It still feels strange to say out loud, that I'm technically a student again.
Radio Host: [curious] What finally prompted the decision, after so many years?
Rina: [thoughtful] Honestly, a kind of quiet dissatisfaction that had been accumulating for years, the sense that I'd optimized my life for stability at the expense of curiosity.
Radio Host: [interested] Was the classroom itself intimidating, sitting among students young enough to be your children?
Rina: [candid] Terrifying, initially. I assumed they'd see me as an oddity, and for the first few weeks I overprepared for every seminar just to compensate for that fear.
Radio Host: [amused] Did that fear turn out to be justified?
Rina: [warmly] Not remotely. If anything, they were curious about my experience rather than dismissive of it, and I found myself mentoring several of them informally by the second semester.
Radio Host: [probing] What's proven hardest, practically speaking, balancing coursework against everything else in your life?
Rina: [honest] The cognitive stamina, surprisingly. I'd forgotten how physically draining sustained concentration can be when you're no longer accustomed to three-hour lectures.
Rina: [reflective] But there's also something my younger classmates don't have yet, a much sharper sense of why I'm doing this, which makes the exhaustion easier to justify.
Radio Host: [curious] Any regret about not doing this sooner?

Rina: [measured] Occasionally, late at night. But I've also come to believe the version of me at twenty-three wouldn't have appreciated this material the way I do now, with actual lived context to attach it to.
Radio Host: [warmly] That's a generous way to frame a delay most people would call regret.
Rina: [smiling] Maybe. Though I'd rather call it timing than failure. The learning arrived exactly when I was finally ready to actually use it.
